summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by OR Royalties Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting a routine portfolio update via press release. The update details positive developments at several mineral properties (Island Gold, Dalgaranga, Glenburgh, etc.) and notes the strategic sale of its Osisko Metals position. There is no transaction with specific financial terms, price per share, premium, or board recommendation. The filing serves as a general operational update, not a special situation triggering a categorization under acquisitions, divestitures, or other event-driven categories.
